'''Field manipulators''' were components used in [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.'s]] [[PLX-2]]. [[Chop Harlison]] used them, along with the weapon's [[guidance package]], as part of the [[Repulsor field/Legends|repulsor field]] control system on his [[Star Slinger]] prototype [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]].
